verdict.rationale: Riskified returns its own decisions: approve/decline on orders, CVV/3DS recommendations via advise, and allow/notify/challenge on logins. Nothing shows ops users mapping score ranges to actions or tuning thresholds themselves. Model calibration is described as done by Riskified's analytics team, which suggests vendor-managed cutoffs rather than merchant-tunable risk appetite.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can map score ranges to actions — allow, review, block, step-up 3DS — and tune thresholds to my own risk appetite instead of a fixed cutoff
